worldcombat.skill.frustration.summary: Let out all the resentment at once: rush in and rake the target several times, each rake a separate hit that shoves it back a little. The less the user likes its Trainer, the heavier, more numerous and faster the rakes; it reads the same number as Return but in the opposite direction, one a flurry, one a single blow.
worldcombat.skill.frustration.use.0: A string of rakes when friendship is low
worldcombat.skill.frustration.use.1: Discharge every grudge at close range
worldcombat.skill.frustration.use.2: Rake a face-hugging foe back step by step
worldcombat.skill.frustration.descriptio: Each rake deals about %1$s contact damage, %2$s rakes in all; the current friendship deficit is %3$s, and a larger deficit makes each rake heavier and adds more of them. Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on every rake separately.

Rush up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, with about %3$s ticks between rakes; each rake has a %4$s block hit radius. If the rush is blocked or cannot advance further, the flurry ends early.
Each rake shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the rake, so a flurry drives it back step by step.
worldcombat.skill.frustration.vent.on: Vent form on: fewer but heavier rakes, each stronger, at the cost of fewer strikes and a longer preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.frustration.vent.off: Vent form off (flurry form): many light, quick rakes that wear a foe down, each weaker.
worldcombat.skill.frustration.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.frustration.preference: On: swap the flurry for fewer, heavier rakes — more power per rake, but fewer strikes and a longer preparation and cooldown. Off: many light, quick rakes that wear a foe down.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of rushing. Larger values chase harder.

When its friendship is not above this value the move becomes a primary option that outranks other attacks (and it is at its strongest then); lower it so only the most estranged individuals prioritise it.
On: raise priority further when the target is below three tenths health, to rake it down. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to rake. Off: it only rakes when the target is already in reach.
